Main Street (approximately 1 block south of garage) Cross Weber Avenue at Hunter Street Walk next to the San Joaquin County Courthouse, through Hunter Square. Turn left onto Main Street. The Bob Hope Theatre is on the right.
venues.accessibleSeatingDetail: Accessible Seating is available on the Floor level of the Theatre. Interpreting Services: Guest requiring interpreting services must contact Guest Services at 209-373-1400 within two (2) weeks of the scheduled event. Service animals for disabled patrons is permitted. Reminder there are no elevators in this historic theatre.
